The '''bombardment of Ruisto''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the aged [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Therbon/Legends|Therbon]] grew frustrated with his inability to retake [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="SOR" /> Since the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] had been unwilling to gather a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] large enough to assault the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the Mon Calamari colony on [[Ruisto]] became a suitable substitute target.<ref name="RES" /> The bombardment of Ruisto was also meant to serve as a training exercise for an eventual attack on the Mon Calamari homeworld.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|114|Ruisto}}</ref>

==The bombardment==
The Empire deployed an [[assault fleet]] comprised of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to bombard Ruisto. The Mon Calamari colony was blasted out of existence and the small [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] were destroyed.<ref name="RES" /> Grand Moff Therbon then ordered a [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|sustained]] [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] that [[Mundicide|wiped out]] all life on Ruisto.<ref name="SOR" />
